map.评估火灾后结构构件损伤程度，输出安全等级与处理建议: Assess the damage degree of structural members after a fire and output a safety grade with handling recommendations.
map.火灾后结构评估按 ISO 834 标准升温曲线，依据火灾最高温度、持续时间与构件: Post-fire assessment follows the ISO 834 standard fire curve: damage is judged from the peak fire temperature, duration and member type (column/beam/slab/wall); the higher the temperature and the longer the exposure, the worse the damage, rated with 6 damage indicators.
map.<300°C：基本无损伤 | 300~600°C：强度下降 20~40% | 6: <300°C: essentially no damage | 300-600°C: 20-40% strength loss | 600-800°C: 50-70% strength loss
map.>800°C：严重损伤，强度丧失 70%以上；粉红色变色约 300~600°C，: >800°C: severe damage, over 70% strength loss; pink discoloration about 300-600°C, gray-white about 600°C+
map.屈服变形/扭曲表明温度曾超 500°C，须重点评估: Yielding/twisting deformation indicates the temperature exceeded 500°C and requires priority assessment
Charring depth estimate: dc ≈ 0.6 × √t (t is the fire-exposure time in minutes); the charring rate is about 0.6-0.8 mm/min

map.按默认参数（构件类型柱、火灾温度 600 ℃、持续时间 2.0 h）：损伤评估分: With the default parameters (member type column, fire temperature 600 °C, duration 2.0 h): damage assessment score 28/100, rated Class II (light damage),
map.强度损失约 30%。因属承重柱、影响整体安全，建议回弹/超声检测强度、钻芯取样、: strength loss of about 30%. As it is a load-bearing column affecting overall safety, rebound/ultrasonic strength testing, core sampling, rebar-corrosion inspection and crack measurement are recommended; handling recommendations: epoxy grouting to repair cracks, section repair and restoration, and steel-jacket strengthening if necessary.
map.温度和时间哪个对损伤影响更大？: Which affects damage more, temperature or time?
map.两者共同决定：温度越高、持续时间越长，混凝土与钢筋强度退化越严重；600℃ 以上: The two act together: the higher the temperature and the longer the duration, the more severely the strength of the concrete and rebar degrades; above 600°C concrete strength loss can reach 20-40%, and the bond between rebar and concrete may weaken due to high-temperature degradation.
map.轻度损伤为什么还要检测？: Why is testing still needed for light damage?
map.外观轻度不代表内部完好，高温可能造成隐蔽裂缝、钢筋锈蚀与强度下降；须经实体检测确: A light appearance does not mean the interior is intact; high temperature may cause hidden cracks, rebar corrosion and strength loss. The actual damage degree must be confirmed by physical testing before deciding whether to strengthen or use directly, and cannot be judged by appearance alone.
map.根据结构类型、火灾温度、持续时间和损伤迹象，评估火灾后构件损伤程度，输出五级安全: Based on structure type, fire temperature, duration and damage signs, assess the damage degree of members after a fire and output a five-level safety grade with handling recommendations.
